description: This file defines callback functions for the Fee module, specifically Job End and Job Error notifications, within an AUTOSAR platform. It only contains function declarations and include guards.

methods.name: Fee_JobEndNotification
methods.description: Declaration of a callback function invoked when a Fee job completes successfully.

methods.name: Fee_JobErrorNotification
methods.description: Declaration of a callback function invoked when a Fee job encounters an error.
